# LS Fencing & Metal Work

> lsfencingandmetalwork.com — Industrial chain link fencing, barrier gates and metal fabrication, Fraser Valley and BC Interior.

LS Fencing & Metal Work installs large-scale commercial and industrial chain link fencing and barrier gates across BC. Cannabis security perimeters, government contracts, industrial yards.

## Services

- Industrial Chain Link Fencing (9-gauge hot-dip galvanized)
- Barrier Gates & Automated Access Control
- Cannabis Facility Security Perimeters
- Custom Metal Gates
- Welding & Metal Fabrication
- Excavation & Post Drilling
- Ornamental & Cedar Fencing

## Service Area

Fraser Valley: Chilliwack, Abbotsford, Langley, Surrey, Maple Ridge
BC Interior: Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George, Penticton, Castlegar, Vernon, Cranbrook, Williams Lake
